_comment: Single data source for Questionnaire B (Phase II participants), rendered by src/feedback-phase2.njk and src/zh/feedback-phase2.njk through src/_includes/questionnaire-b-form.njk. Every question, option code, condition and both languages live here, so the two pages cannot drift; scripts/verify-questionnaire.mjs fails CI (npm run verify:all) if the built pages differ in field names, option codes/order, conditions, required conditions or the draft key. Participant-facing text is verbatim from Questionnaire_B_spec_bilingual.md (sha256 f69609da…cb79); where B repeats an A question it keeps A's field name, codes and (for the Section 3 issue and stage options) A's option text. A section holds `questions`, or `subsections` that hold `questions` or labelled `groups`. `options` is an inline list or the key of a set in `optionSets`; a scale's `extra` names a set appended after its numbers (B5.2's "Didn't use" [na]). `showIf` and `requiredIf` are lists of {field, anyOf} tests OR'd together: a hidden question is disabled (never submitted) and cleared; a required question blocks submit while empty and shows text[requiredMsg] beside it. `num: true` marks the spec's numbered questions that are always shown (B5.2 is one numbered group of eight scales); conditional questions and the spec's unnumbered follow-ups are unnumbered. Answers are saved as a draft in localStorage under `draftKey`. The page closes itself at `closesAt` (end of 22 Oct 2026 AoE).

title.zh: 第二阶段队伍反馈问卷

description.en: This questionnaire is for everyone on a team that took part in Phase II of the EBiM Benchmark Competition 2026.
description.zh: 本问卷面向参加了 EBiM Benchmark Competition 2026 第二阶段的所有队伍成员，约需 15–20 分钟。

intro.en: This questionnaire is for everyone on a team that took part in Phase II of the EBiM Benchmark Competition 2026. It takes about 15–20 minutes. Every question is optional. One response per person, please. It closes on 22 October 2026 (AoE).
intro.zh: 本问卷面向参加了 EBiM Benchmark Competition 2026 第二阶段的所有队伍成员，约需 15–20 分钟。所有问题均为选答。请每人填写一份。问卷于 2026 年 10 月 22 日（AoE）截止。

confidentiality.en: Your answers are read only by the EBiM organizers, reported only in aggregate, and never quoted or attributed to you without your permission. Results are final, and nothing here can affect them.
confidentiality.zh: 您的回答仅由 EBiM 组委会阅读，仅以汇总形式报告；未经您许可，我们不会引用您的回答或注明出处。比赛结果已为最终结果，本问卷不会对其产生任何影响。

draftLine.en: Your answers are saved in this browser as you go, so you can close the page and come back later.
draftLine.zh: 您的回答会随填写自动保存在本浏览器中，可随时关闭页面，稍后继续填写。

switchLine.en: To answer in 中文, switch language before you start. Your answers so far are kept.
switchLine.zh: 如需使用 English 作答，请在开始前切换语言。已填写的内容会保留。

required.en: This is needed for the choice you made above.
required.zh: 您在上方所作的选择需要填写此项。

team.en: Please enter your team in Section 1.
team.zh: 请在第 1 部分填写您所在的队伍。

privacy.en: We use your answers only to improve future EBiM competitions and to report on this edition in aggregate. They are read only by the EBiM organizers. Your answers about the Franka platform go to Franka Robotics GmbH only as you chose in Section 10, and material is shared with them only for the items you ticked there. We remove names from free-text answers before sharing anything. Your email address, if you give it, is used only for what you ticked. We don't sell your information. Submissions are processed by Web3Forms.
privacy.zh: 您的回答仅用于改进今后的 EBiM 竞赛，以及以汇总形式报告本届情况，仅由 EBiM 组委会阅读。您对 Franka 平台的回答只会按您在第 10 部分的选择提供给 Franka Robotics GmbH；相关素材也只会按您在该部分勾选的项目与其分享。分享前我们会删除自由填写内容中的姓名。如您留下邮箱，仅用于您勾选的用途。我们不会出售您的信息。表单由 Web3Forms 处理。

thanks.en: Thank you. We have your answers. If you asked to join the email list, to talk with us, or gave consent in Section 10, we'll use the address you gave only for those purposes.
thanks.zh: 感谢您的填写，我们已收到您的回答。如您选择加入邮件列表、参加后续交流，或在第 10 部分作出了授权，我们只会将您留下的邮箱用于这些用途。

error.en: Your answers could not be sent. Please try again, or email them to organizers@ebim-benchmark.org.
error.zh: 提交未成功。请重试，或将您的回答发送至 organizers@ebim-benchmark.org。

noscript.en: JavaScript is required to submit this form (the spam check needs it). If you can't enable it, email organizers@ebim-benchmark.org.
noscript.zh: 提交本问卷需要启用 JavaScript（反垃圾验证需要）。如无法启用，请发送邮件至 organizers@ebim-benchmark.org。

closed.en: This questionnaire closed on 22 October 2026. Thank you to everyone who answered.
closed.zh: 本问卷已于 2026 年 10 月 22 日截止。感谢所有填写问卷的朋友。
